subject: Re: ACME Payments — VPC/private deployment interest
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@acmepayments.com>
Cc: ACME Payments Procurement <procurement@acmepayments.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: ACME Payments — VPC/private deployment next steps

Thanks for the time today, Sofia — really appreciated the candid discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery call: 

- Need: ACME Payments is prioritizing a private/VPC deployment for data residency and audit control on the payments workload.
- Primary concerns: KMS integration, long-term audit log retention (7+ years), and token-level cost predictability for high-throughput inference.
- Timeline you mentioned: pilot in early Q1 2027, decision by end of Q1 if pilot looks good.

Proposed next steps from Redwood:
1) Share our VPC overview and a draft SOW for an initial pilot (attached).
2) Set a technical deep-dive with our Security/SE folks to cover KMS options, network topology, and audit logs (I recommend looping in Dev Patel from our security/SE team).
3) Provide a high-level pricing range for dedicated capacity to help you budget while you evaluate.

Attachments: redwood-vpc-overview.pdf, SOW-ACME-VPC-draft.docx (draft SOW — will tailor after the deep-dive).

Action for you: Can you confirm that the pilot timeline (early Q1) and KMS/audit requirements are the right priorities? If so I'll schedule a 60-minute technical dive next week.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood-vpc-overview.pdf]
[Attachment: SOW-ACME-VPC-draft.docx]

From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@acmepayments.com>

Subject: Re: ACME Payments — VPC/private deployment next steps

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the recap — this aligns with our notes. A couple quick clarifications: 
- Can you share a ballpark for monthly committed pricing for a pilot (we're OK with a range).
- Is dedicated capacity always required for a VPC/private deployment, or are there hybrid options during pilot?

If you can send a short pricing range and whether SE should be involved now, I'll confirm availability for the technical session.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Alvarez
Head of Platform Engineering | ACME Payments
sofia.alvarez@acmepayments.com

Sofia — quick follow-up (bumping this thread).

I wanted to share a short pricing quicksheet so you have ranges to discuss internally: [Attachment: vpc-pricing-quicksheet.pdf]. High level: a pilot for dedicated capacity usually starts in the mid-five-figure/month range depending on concurrency and throughput; hybrid options are possible in some cases (shared control plane + customer VPC peering) — happy to go into details on a call.

If it helps, I can schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive next week and loop in our SE/security lead (Dev Patel) to cover KMS, audit logs, network topology, and the SOW items. Would early next week (Tue/Wed) work for you?

Also confirming we sent the SOW draft — we'll tailor after the tech session.

If priorities have shifted and this is no longer a near-term effort, let me know so we don't keep pinging you.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

- Prepare a tailored SOW and a firm pilot pricing estimate.

If priorities have changed, could you let me know the expected timing so we can align? No problem either way — want to make sure our outreach is helpful not noisy.
